verdict.rationale: Unit's platform page links to an API reference ("Explore the API"), and API docs pages exist, such as the Webhook Events page under /docs/api/. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, a sandbox-backed request runner, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
